title: 2D V2C MXene/2D g-C3N4 nanosheet heterojunctions constructed via a one-pot method for remedying water pollution through high-efficient adsorption together with in situ photocatalytic degradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1792-1804
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07222G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shishan Xue, Dengliang He, Herong Zhang, Yuning Zhang, Yu Wang, Yurong Zeng, Shuxin Liu, Ning Chen
2D V2C MXene/2D g-C3N4 nanosheet heterojunctions was exploited in this work, which almost completely removed dye pollutants (RhB and CV) with the removal ratio of 99.5%. This work is significant for the field of wastewater treatment.
